**Pattern to follow for forward:**
```typescript
public static forwardMessage = async (roomId: string, eventId: string, content: string) => {
  if (!this.instance) throw new Error("Client not initialized");
  const room = this.instance.getRoom(roomId);
  if (!room) throw new Error("Room not found");
  const timeline = await room.timeline();
  if (!timeline) throw new Error("Timeline not found");
  // Send message using timeline.send() with the content
};
```
